lesson: When the user asks a single question without explicit action verbs (e.g. 'how does X work'), classify intent as project_question rather than task — do not spawn a pipeline for informational queries.
rationale: Common failure: ambiguous single-sentence queries like '这个怎么用' or 'what does this module do' are incorrectly routed to task pipelines, wasting reflection budget on non-actionable intents. Check for action verbs (实现/修复/重构/add/fix/refactor) before escalating to task.
